filing_type: Annual report issuer guidance and targets review
notes: Manually reviewed forward-looking statements from Aramco's official 2025 annual report. Every record is issuer guidance, an issuer target, an issuer outlook, or an issuer ambition; none is an analyst estimate or consensus forecast. PDF page is the physical page in the archived file and printed page is the number printed in the report.

disclosures.title: 2026 capital spending peak outlook
disclosures.body_text: Management expects capital spending on currently identified liquids, downstream and new-energy opportunities to peak during 2026. Potential additional spending later in the decade is conditioned on finding accretive opportunities; no amount is asserted by this record.

conditions: potential additional spending would be directed at accretive opportunities
metadata.quote: We expect capital spending on current opportunities including liquids, downstream, and new energies to peak in 2026

disclosures.title: 2030 sales gas production capacity growth target
disclosures.body_text: Aramco aims to increase sales gas production capacity by approximately 80% by 2030 from the 2021 level. The target is subject to domestic demand and includes pre-FID projects not yet announced.

conditions: inclusive of pre-FID projects not yet announced
metadata.quote: Aramco aims to increase its gas production by approximately 80% by 2030 from 2021 production levels

disclosures.title: 2030 total gas and associated liquids outlook
disclosures.body_text: Alongside its sales-gas expansion, Aramco anticipates total gas and associated liquids production of approximately 6 mmboed by 2030, including an increase of more than 1 mmbpd in high-value associated liquids.

conditions: anticipated result of the sales-gas capacity growth plan
metadata.quote: the Company anticipates total gas and associated liquids of approximately six mmboed by 2030

disclosures.title: Jafurah 2030 production ramp targets
disclosures.body_text: Aramco expects the Jafurah development to ramp progressively by 2030 to 2 bscfd of sales gas, 420 mmscfd of ethane and 630 mbpd of high-value liquids and condensates.

metadata.quote: 2 bscfd of sales gas, 420 mmscfd of ethane, and 630 mbpd of high-value liquids and condensates by 2030

disclosures.title: Fadhili 2027 capacity outlook
disclosures.body_text: The Fadhili Gas Plant expansion is expected to add 1.5 bscfd of raw-gas processing capacity, corresponding to approximately 1.15 bscfd of sales-gas production capacity, by 2027.

metadata.quote: additional raw gas processing capacity of 1.5 bscfd (approximately 1.15 bscfd of sales gas production capacity) by 2027

disclosures.title: Long-term liquids-to-chemicals capacity goal
disclosures.body_text: Aramco states a long-term goal of increasing capacity at petrochemical-producing complexes to as much as 4 million barrels per day through selected, disciplined liquids-to-chemicals investments. The report does not specify a completion year for this goal.

metadata.quote: with a long-term goal to increase its capacity in petrochemical producing complexes to up to four million barrels per day

disclosures.title: 2026 Upstream operating outlook
disclosures.body_text: For 2026, Aramco says Upstream will continue growing the gas business, including LNG investments, while maintaining maximum sustainable crude capacity through additional crude increments. This is qualitative issuer outlook rather than quantified earnings guidance.

metadata.quote: Aramco’s Upstream segment will continue to drive growth in its gas business, including LNG investments

disclosures.title: 2026 Downstream strategic outlook
disclosures.body_text: For 2026, Aramco says Downstream plans to expand and integrate across the hydrocarbon value chain, including strategic refining capacity, liquids-to-chemicals, trading, retail and lubricants. This is qualitative issuer outlook rather than quantified earnings guidance.

metadata.quote: the Downstream segment plans to increase refining capacity in strategic locations

disclosures.title: 2030 iktva local spending target
disclosures.body_text: After reaching 70% locally sourced supply-chain expenditure in 2025, Aramco set a new target of 75% local spending by 2030 under the iktva program.

metadata.quote: has now established an updated target of 75% local spending by 2030

disclosures.title: 2050 operational net-zero ambition
disclosures.body_text: Aramco's stated ambition is net-zero Scope 1 and Scope 2 greenhouse-gas emissions by 2050 across wholly owned operated assets. It is recorded as an issuer ambition, not as a guaranteed forecast or an economy-wide Scope 3 target.

metadata.quote: Saudi Aramco’s ambition is to achieve net-zero Scope 1 and Scope 2 greenhouse gas emissions by 2050 across its wholly-owned operated assets
